title: LLM Serving Optimization with Variable Prefill and Decode Lengths
abstract: arXiv:2508.06133v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study offline scheduling for large language model (LLM) serving under a fixed KV-cache memory budget, where requests have heterogeneous prompt (prefill) and response (decode) lengths. Given a backlog of requests available at time zero, the scheduler forms mixed prefill/decode batches over time to minimize total end-to-end latency. We show that heterogeneity in prompt lengths fundamentally changes the problem: minimizing total latency is NP-hard, and standard policies that prioritize short outputs or small total sequence sizes can have unbounded approximation ratios. We propose Sorted-F, which repeatedly selects feasible batches using an F-metric that balances batch cardinality against downstream decode cost. With exact batch selection, Sorted-F achieves a constant-factor approximation guarantee in the unit-time, uninterrupted-decoding model with known output lengths; the guarantee also holds under a static peak-memory batch

translated_title: 具有可变预填充与解码长度的LLM服务优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.06133v5 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：我们研究了在固定KV缓存内存预算下大型语言模型（LLM）服务的离线调度问题，其中请求具有异构的提示（预填充）长度和响应（解码）长度。给定时刻零点已到达的一批积压请求，调度器需随时间构建混合预填充/解码批次，以最小化总端到端延迟。我们证明提示长度的异构性从根本上改变了问题的性质：最小化总延迟是NP难问题，且优先考虑短输出或小总序列长度的标准策略可能具有无界的近似比。我们提出Sorted-F算法，它反复使用一种F度量来选择可行批次，该度量在批次规模与下游解码成本之间取得平衡。在精确批次选择下，Sorted-F在单位时间、无中断解码且输出长度已知的模型中实现了常数因子近似保证；该保证在静态峰值内存批次约束下同样成立。
tldr: 该论文证明了在异构预填充与解码长度下最小化LLM服务总延迟是NP难问题，并提出Sorted-F算法，通过F度量平衡批次规模与下游解码成本，实现了常数因子近似保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that minimizing total latency in LLM serving with heterogeneous prefill and decode lengths is NP-hard, and proposes Sorted-F, which achieves constant-factor approximation guarantees by using an F-metric that balances batch cardinality against downstream decode cost.
